title: CredentialStoreError as typed enum with non_exhaustive
description: The error enum uses thiserror with structured fields (label, line_num, username) rather than String-wrapping variants. #[non_exhaustive] added so new variants can be added without breaking downstream matchers. This is correct library design. A future contributor might suggest simplifying to anyhow::Error or Box<dyn Error> — resist this, because callers of from_file/from_content need to distinguish BadHash from MalformedLine from Io to produce actionable operator error messages.
